althingi_lagasafn.name: Alþingi — Lagasafn
althingi_lagasafn.notes: Use the live official law page for verification. Bulk SGML snapshots are useful for discovery/indexing but can lag later amendments.

althingi_open_xml.name: Alþingi — open parliamentary XML
althingi_open_xml.notes: Official open XML: bills/matters, committee stages, speeches, votes. Alþingi warns that most exports lack a formal schema, may change without notice, and normally update daily. Requires a non-default User-Agent (default httpx UA gets 403'd) and mixed D.M.YYYY/ISO date formats depending on endpoint; parse responses as bytes, not decoded text.

domar_island_is.name: Dómar — island.is (unified court verdict register)
domar_island_is.authority_label: Official court judgment — precedential weight varies by court (see per-ruling authority_class: C1 Hæstiréttur, C2 Landsréttur, C3 héraðsdómur)
domar_island_is.notes: Covers all three court levels (43k+ rulings) through one public, unauthenticated GraphQL endpoint (webVerdicts for search, webVerdictById for one ruling). The old per-court sites (heradsdomstolar.is/landsrettur.is/haestirettur.is) now just 301-redirect here. Full text is structured richText for some rulings (mainly recent Hæstiréttur) and a base64 PDF for others (older/lower-court rulings), extracted with pdfplumber — PDF extraction can carry artifacts, flagged via text_source on the result. The court-name search filter is confirmed reliable only for 'Hæstiréttur'; 'Landsréttur' and héraðsdómur names silently return zero results even though those exact strings appear in the data (verified against the live endpoint) — filter by court client-side for other courts. island.is itself serves no robots.txt (404, not a disallow), unlike the old per-court sites. A whole-law citation filter (search_court_rulings' law_citation param, format 'NNN/YYYY' converted to the upstream 'YYYY.NNN' tag) is confirmed working via live UI network capture — a real curated citation tag, sparse but genuine. Article-level citation filtering is explicitly marked 'í vinnslu' (in development) on island.is's own search UI and was confirmed unreliable in testing (an unrecognized article tag silently returns ~31k of ~43k rulings instead of 0) — not exposed by this tool.

reglugerdasafn.name: Reglugerðasafn (island.is regulation register)
reglugerdasafn.authority_label: Official consolidated regulation text — subordinate to its enabling statute
reglugerdasafn.notes: Public, unauthenticated JSON REST API (no HTML scraping needed): /regulation/{nnnn-yyyy}/{current|original}/ returns full text, ministry, dates, amendment history and effects; /search does free-text lookup. A regulation only has legal effect within the bounds of the statute (lög) that authorizes it — its 'law_basis' clause is the regulation's own claim of authority, extracted by this PoC via pattern match, not a verified structured field. Regulations from before the register's digitization return a stub pointing at a legacy scan (www.reglugerd.is/reglugerdir/allar/nr/{id}) instead of structured text.

ees_gagnagrunnur.name: EES-gagnagrunnur
ees_gagnagrunnur.publisher: Stjórnarráð Íslands / Ministry for Foreign Affairs
ees_gagnagrunnur.notes: Tracks EEA acts and Icelandic handling. Do not equate an EU act or EEA relevance with domestic Icelandic applicability. The database states that Iceland-specific information before its 2017 introduction may be incomplete.

efta_eea_lex.name: EFTA — EEA-Lex
efta_eea_lex.notes: Useful for EEA incorporation/JCD factsheets. EFTA states EEA-Lex is informational and does not replace applicable legal sources.

eur_lex.name: EUR-Lex / CELLAR
eur_lex.publisher: Publications Office of the European Union
eur_lex.notes: An EU act appearing here must never, by that fact alone, be represented as applicable Icelandic law.

stjornartidindi.name: Stjórnartíðindi
stjornartidindi.notes: PoC registry entry only; a structured adapter should be added once a reliable supported interface is confirmed.
